chapter: Leaving music: Klessy and the Millers
title: Philly and Teddy Miller, the Prunes song and Freddie joining Klessy's band
summary: He recalls a session at the Cadillac, Teddy Miller's tunes, and how young banjo player Freddie Loyacano enlarged Klessy's band. Teddy's father was a one-man band on Canal Street.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor
